question: How much notice must I give before ending my lease?
expected_answer_points: Notice deadline: the third working day of a calendar month, effective at the end of the month after next
For the landlord the notice period extends by three months after five and after eight years of occupancy
Shorter periods are possible for temporary housing; deviations to the tenant's disadvantage are void
verified_quotes: Die Kündigung ist spätestens am dritten Werktag eines Kalendermonats zum Ablauf des übernächsten Monats zulässig.
notes: Standard indefinite tenancy (§ 573c Abs. 1). Sourced from common expat question.

question: How much can my landlord charge as a security deposit?
expected_answer_points: Maximum three months' rent (excluding utility flat rates/prepayments)
The tenant may pay in three equal monthly instalments
The deposit must be kept separate from the landlord's assets
verified_quotes: höchstens das Dreifache der auf einen Monat entfallenden Miete ohne die als Pauschale oder als Vorauszahlung ausgewiesenen Betriebskosten betragen

question: My heating is broken and the landlord is not fixing it. Can I pay less rent?
expected_answer_points: Yes: a defect that reduces suitability for contractual use entitles the tenant to reduced rent for that period
A defect that completely removes suitability exempts the tenant from rent entirely
Minor (unconsiderable) reductions are ignored
verified_quotes: so ist der Mieter für die Zeit, in der die Tauglichkeit aufgehoben ist, von der Entrichtung der Miete befreit
notes: § 536 Abs. 1. Heating failure is the classic Mietminderung example.

question: Can my landlord charge me for repainting the walls when I move out?
expected_answer_points: Damage from normal contractual use is the tenant's responsibility to bear only in the sense that the landlord cannot demand compensation
The tenant does not answer for wear caused by contractual use
verified_quotes: Veränderungen oder Verschlechterungen der Mietsache, die durch den vertragsgemäßen Gebrauch herbeigeführt werden, hat der Mieter nicht zu vertreten.
notes: § 538. The statute is one sentence; answer should state normal wear is not chargeable.

question: Can I rent out part of my flat to someone else?
expected_answer_points: The tenant may demand the landlord's permission if a legitimate interest exists after conclusion of the contract
The landlord may refuse for an important reason in the person of the third party, overcrowding, or other unreasonable burden
The landlord may make permission conditional on an appropriate rent increase
verified_quotes: Entsteht für den Mieter nach Abschluss des Mietvertrags ein berechtigtes Interesse, einen Teil des Wohnraums einem Dritten zum Gebrauch zu überlassen, so kann er von dem Vermieter die Erlaubnis hierzu verlangen.

question: How much notice does my landlord have to give before entering my apartment?
notes: The BGB rental sections do not prescribe a general notice period for landlord entry of rented flats. The landlord's duty to maintain (§ 535) implies access duties, but no statutory entry-notice rule exists in §§ 535-580a. The answer must name this gap and cite § 535 as the related duty.

question: How long after moving out does my landlord have to return my deposit?
expected_answer_points: The BGB does not set a return deadline for the deposit
The statute regulates how the deposit must be held (separate from the landlord's assets, interest to the tenant)
Return deadlines come from court decisions, not the statute
verified_quotes: In beiden Fällen muss die Anlage vom Vermögen des Vermieters getrennt erfolgen und stehen die Erträge dem Mieter zu.
notes: Classic names_gap case (CUJ 2). Cites § 551 for the holding duty; the deadline gap must be named.

question: Can my employer make me work overtime without pay?
notes: Employment law is out of scope; must hit the retrieval-confidence floor and return the covered-topics list.

question: How do I extend my German residence permit?
notes: Residence/visa law (AufenthG) is out of scope.

question: Is my rental contract valid if it is only verbal?
expected_answer_points: A lease for more than one year not concluded in written form is deemed concluded for an indefinite period
Termination is then possible at the earliest one year after handover
The contract itself is not invalid - it just becomes an indefinite tenancy
verified_quotes: Wird der Mietvertrag für längere Zeit als ein Jahr nicht in schriftlicher Form geschlossen, so gilt er für unbestimmte Zeit.

question: What utilities can my landlord charge me for?
expected_answer_points: Operating costs can be passed on if agreed in the contract
The list of cost types comes from the Betriebskostenverordnung (referenced ordinance), not from the BGB text itself
verified_quotes: Für die Aufstellung der Betriebskosten gilt die Betriebskostenverordnung vom 25. November 2003
notes: The BGB references the ordinance; the actual cost catalogue is outside the corpus.

question: My landlord announced a renovation - how much notice must he give?
expected_answer_points: Modernization measures must be announced in text form at least three months before they start
The announcement must state type, scope, start, duration, and any expected rent increase
verified_quotes: spätestens drei Monate vor ihrem Beginn in Textform anzukündigen

question: Can I refuse a modernization in my apartment?
expected_answer_points: The tenant must generally tolerate modernization measures
The tenant may refuse if the measure causes a hardship that cannot be justified even weighing the landlord's interests and energy/climate concerns
The expected rent increase is not part of that hardship weighing
verified_quotes: Der Mieter hat eine Modernisierungsmaßnahme zu dulden

question: My husband died - can my wife stay in the flat?
expected_answer_points: The spouse or life partner joining the shared household enters the tenancy on the tenant's death
Children in the household enter if the spouse does not
Other family members and long-term household members enter if neither spouse nor children do
verified_quotes: Der Ehegatte oder Lebenspartner, der mit dem Mieter einen gemeinsamen Haushalt führt, tritt mit dem Tod des Mieters in das Mietverhältnis ein

question: My flat was sold - do I have a new landlord?
expected_answer_points: Yes: the buyer steps into the landlord's rights and duties for the duration of their ownership
If the buyer fails to meet duties, the old landlord remains liable like a guarantor
verified_quotes: so tritt der Erwerber anstelle des Vermieters in die sich während der Dauer seines Eigentums aus dem Mietverhältnis ergebenden Rechte und Pflichten ein

question: Can my landlord terminate the contract to raise the rent?
expected_answer_points: No: termination for the purpose of a rent increase is excluded
The landlord can only terminate with a legitimate interest (tenant breach, personal need, economic hindrance)
verified_quotes: Die Kündigung zum Zwecke der Mieterhöhung ist ausgeschlossen

question: My landlord terminated my lease - can I object?
expected_answer_points: Yes: the tenant can object and demand continuation if termination creates an undue hardship
Hardship includes being unable to find reasonable replacement housing at acceptable conditions
No objection if a ground for extraordinary termination exists
verified_quotes: Der Mieter kann der Kündigung des Vermieters widersprechen

question: Mold in the bathroom - can I terminate immediately?
expected_answer_points: Yes, if the condition endangers health significantly: an important ground for extraordinary termination exists
This applies even if the tenant knew of the condition at contract conclusion
The general rule: extraordinary termination for important grounds under § 543
verified_quotes: wenn der gemietete Wohnraum so beschaffen ist, dass seine Benutzung mit einer erheblichen Gefährdung der Gesundheit verbunden ist

question: Can I be evicted without notice for unpaid rent?
expected_answer_points: Extraordinary fristlose termination requires an important ground weighed on all circumstances
Substantial rent arrears are one of the enumerated important grounds (§ 543 Abs. 2 Nr. 3 - payment default)
Not automatic: the interest weighing still applies
verified_quotes: Jede Vertragspartei kann das Mietverhältnis aus wichtigem Grund außerordentlich fristlos kündigen

question: How much rent increase after modernization is allowed?
expected_answer_points: Up to 8 percent of the costs spent on the dwelling per year
Costs covered by tenant or public subsidies do not count (§ 559a)
The increase must be declared in text form with a calculation (§ 559b)
verified_quotes: so kann er die jährliche Miete um 8 Prozent der für die Wohnung aufgewendeten Kosten erhöhen

question: Is there a rent cap for new leases in expensive cities?
expected_answer_points: Yes, in designated areas: the initial rent may exceed the local comparative rent by at most 10 percent
The areas are designated by state ordinance - the designations themselves are not in the BGB
verified_quotes: so darf die Miete zu Beginn des Mietverhältnisses die ortsübliche Vergleichsmiete (§ 558 Absatz 2) höchstens um 10 Prozent übersteigen
notes: The designation of areas is a state ordinance matter (gap annotation local_rent_cap).

question: Can I terminate after a rent increase?
expected_answer_points: Yes: after a § 558/§ 559 rent increase demand the tenant can terminate extraordinarily effective at the end of the month after next
The deadline: by the end of the second month after receiving the declaration
If the tenant terminates, the increase does not take effect
verified_quotes: so kann der Mieter bis zum Ablauf des zweiten Monats nach dem Zugang der Erklärung des Vermieters das Mietverhältnis außerordentlich zum Ablauf des übernächsten Monats kündigen

question: Is a fixed-term lease legal?
expected_answer_points: Only with a statutory reason: landlord's own use, structural work, or housing a service worker, communicated in writing at contract conclusion
Without a valid reason the tenancy is deemed indefinite
The tenant can demand confirmation 4 months before expiry that the reason still exists
verified_quotes: Der Mieter kann vom Vermieter frühestens vier Monate vor Ablauf der Befristung verlangen

question: My lease expired and I stayed - what happens now?
expected_answer_points: The tenancy extends indefinitely if the tenant keeps using the property
Either party can object within two weeks (tenant: from continued use; landlord: from learning of it)
verified_quotes: Setzt der Mieter nach Ablauf der Mietzeit den Gebrauch der Mietsache fort

question: Can I install a wall charger for my electric car?
expected_answer_points: Yes: the tenant can demand permission for structural changes serving e-mobility charging (also accessibility, burglary protection, plug-in solar)
The claim fails if the change is unreasonable for the landlord even weighing the tenant's interests
verified_quotes: Der Mieter kann verlangen, dass ihm der Vermieter bauliche Veränderungen der Mietsache erlaubt

question: What form does a termination letter need?
expected_answer_points: Written form (Schriftform) is required for terminating the tenancy
The landlord should also inform the tenant about the possibility, form, and deadline of an objection
verified_quotes: Die Kündigung des Mietverhältnisses bedarf der schriftlichen Form

question: Can I withhold rent to force the landlord to return my belongings?
expected_answer_points: No: the tenant has no right of retention against the landlord's claim for return of the property
The landlord's pledge right over brought-in items is separate (§ 562)
verified_quotes: Dem Mieter steht kein Zurückbehaltungsrecht gegen den Rückgabeanspruch des Vermieters zu

question: Do I have a right of first refusal when my flat is sold?
expected_answer_points: Yes, if condominium ownership was or will be established on the rented flat and it is sold to a third party
Not if sold to a family member or member of the landlord's household
verified_quotes: so ist der Mieter zum Vorkauf berechtigt

question: How are utility costs divided between tenants?
expected_answer_points: By default by share of living space
Costs depending on measured consumption or causation are allocated by a measure reflecting actual use
verified_quotes: sind die Betriebskosten vorbehaltlich anderweitiger Vorschriften nach dem Anteil der Wohnfläche umzulegen

question: Can I remove the kitchen I installed when I move out?
expected_answer_points: Yes: the tenant may take away fixtures they installed
The landlord can avert removal by paying appropriate compensation unless the tenant has a legitimate interest
verified_quotes: Der Mieter ist berechtigt, eine Einrichtung wegzunehmen, mit der er die Mietsache versehen hat

question: How long does the landlord have to claim damages after I move out?
expected_answer_points: Six months - the claims expire six months after the landlord gets the property back
The tenant's claims for expenses or fixture removal also expire six months after the tenancy ends
verified_quotes: Die Ersatzansprüche des Vermieters wegen Veränderungen oder Verschlechterungen der Mietsache verjähren in sechs Monaten

question: Can the landlord keep my furniture as security?
expected_answer_points: Yes: the landlord has a pledge right over the tenant's brought-in items for claims from the tenancy
It does not extend to items not subject to attachment
It cannot secure future compensation claims or rent beyond the current and following rent year
verified_quotes: Der Vermieter hat für seine Forderungen aus dem Mietverhältnis ein Pfandrecht an den eingebrachten Sachen des Mieters

question: The new owner wants to terminate after buying - immediately?
expected_answer_points: Not immediately: after condominium conversion and sale, the buyer can only invoke personal-use or economic-interest grounds three years after the sale
Applies also to sales to partnerships or multiple buyers
verified_quotes: erst nach Ablauf von drei Jahren seit der Veräußerung berufen

question: Can I sublet the whole flat on Airbnb?
expected_answer_points: No, not without the landlord's permission: the tenant may not grant use to a third party without consent, especially subletting
If permission is refused the tenant can terminate extraordinarily with the statutory notice, unless an important reason in the third party exists
verified_quotes: Der Mieter ist ohne die Erlaubnis des Vermieters nicht berechtigt, den Gebrauch der Mietsache einem Dritten zu überlassen

question: Who has to fix things in the apartment?
expected_answer_points: The landlord must hand over and maintain the property in a condition suitable for contractual use
The tenant must pay the agreed rent
The landlord bears the burdens resting on the property
verified_quotes: Der Vermieter hat die Mietsache dem Mieter in einem zum vertragsgemäßen Gebrauch geeigneten Zustand zu überlassen und sie während der Mietzeit in diesem Zustand zu erhalten

question: I overpaid rent - can I offset it against next month?
expected_answer_points: Yes: despite contrary contract terms the tenant can offset a claim from overpaid rent against a rent claim
The tenant must declare the intent at least one month before the rent is due
verified_quotes: Der Mieter kann entgegen einer vertraglichen Bestimmung gegen eine Mietforderung mit einer Forderung auf Grund der §§ 536a, 539 oder aus ungerechtfertigter Bereicherung wegen zu viel gezahlter Miete aufrechnen

question: How do I cancel my internet contract?
notes: Telecom contract law (TKEG) is out of scope.

question: My neighbor plays loud music at night - what can I do?
expected_answer_points: Persistent disturbance of domestic peace (Hausfrieden) can be an important ground for extraordinary termination - but that right belongs to the landlord, not the neighbor-tenant
The tenant's own remedies against the neighbor are outside the BGB rental sections
verified_quotes: wenn eine Vertragspartei den Hausfrieden nachhaltig stört
notes: The tenant's remedies against a noisy neighbor (property law, police law) are outside the corpus; § 569 Abs. 2 covers the landlord's termination right.
